_comment: display.c map_glyphinfo() (2620-2632) colors the hero after reset_glyphmap() has stored its glyph color. On the Rogue level without Rogue IBM colors, reset_glyphmap() turns every stored color off, but the showrace tweak still paints the hero HI_DOMESTIC. The debug-mode dwarven Archeologist with showrace level-teleports to the Rogue level and appears as a white 'h'. The port used to fold the tweak into the stored color, which the Rogue symset's nocolor then removed.
